name: Broken Attic Lock
description: The lockbox's lock was picked with a tool, not forced -- suggesting someone skilled or professional.

name: Fee Schedule Letter
description: A letter showing Warren's fee under the new will is less than a third of what the old will guarantees him as executor.

name: Spare Attic Key
description: A spare attic key found tucked in Warren's briefcase, which he claimed he'd never used.

name: Disturbed Garden Soil
description: A small patch of freshly turned soil near the garden shed, oddly out of place.

name: Old Will Draft
description: An early draft of the newer will with Warren's handwritten margin notes complaining about its terms.
